english: I am what you will be; I was what you are

terms.latin: Sum quod eris; fuī quod es.
terms.comment: Traupman: from a Roman tombstone. We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
